skirmish.module.holyworld_os.name: HolyWorld OS
skirmish.module.holyworld_os.description: All of HolyWorld in one app window (key O). Events: what starts soon, events near you with a route, the Prime timetable and the best events on every Lite. Economy: auction price history with a chart, good deals and what your base storage is worth. Anarchies: every server with its events and vote. Guide: regions, schedule, rarity, mod rules, keys. Profile: session stats, sidebar data and what Skirmish keeps for you. Read-only — sends nothing to the server.
skirmish.module.holyworld_os.setting.ope: Key for the HolyWorld OS window
skirmish.hwos.title: HolyWorld OS
skirmish.hwos.readonly: Read-only: API data, auction pages, your base and the sidebar
skirmish.hwos.events.commander_off: Turn on Event Commander — it works out what starts when.
skirmish.hwos.events.no_marks: When event coordinates show up in chat, a waypoint appears here. Click to make it the target.
skirmish.hwos.events.no_live: No events now (or the data is still loading)
skirmish.hwos.economy.empty: No prices yet. Browse the auction — Market remembers the lots and charts appear here.
skirmish.hwos.economy.deals: Good deals (25%+ under the usual price)
skirmish.hwos.economy.no_deals: Nothing notably cheaper than usual in the last 2 hours
skirmish.hwos.anarchies.loading: The anarchy list is still loading from api.holyworld.me
skirmish.hwos.guide.regions_note: From the HolyWorld wiki. Lite gives no region height; the block is in the centre.
skirmish.hwos.guide.local_time: Times on the right are your local time (%s)
skirmish.hwos.guide.rule.scripts: scripts that react to the surroundings by themselves (e.g. auto-disconnect)
skirmish.hwos.guide.rule.invisible: mods that reveal invisible players indirectly (indicators, minimaps) — per the FAQ
skirmish.hwos.guide.rule.invisible_block: highlighting the block an invisible player stands on
skirmish.hwos.guide.rules_note: A short version of the server rules; the exact text and new items are on the HolyWorld site. Skirmish shows nothing through walls and does nothing for you.
skirmish.hwos.profile.no_sidebar: The sidebar has no «Label: value» lines
